rationale: The dependency marker-name guard, pinned from both sides. `DEPENDS_ON_KEYS` fires on four loader spellings (Compose `depends_on`, GitHub `needs`, Azure `dependsOn`, CircleCI `requires`), and in every one of them the value names a DECLARATION the document carries -- except one measured position: kube-api-linter's config spells a rule-to-marker requirement `dependenttags.rules[].dependsOn: ["k8s:optional"]`, where the value is a kubebuilder MARKER (a Go-comment annotation `+k8s:optional`), not a key any analyzer publishes in any lane. The edge it produced (target `k8s:optional`, `isExternal: true`) was structurally unverifiable: no symbol named `k8s:optional` can exist in the key space. MEASURED whole admitted population, every `yaml_depends_on` target counted UNTRUNCATED (1,895 edges, .tmp-probe/yaml-depends-position-r16.txt): 1,892 carry no colon; the only colon-bearing, template-free targets are the 3 `k8s:optional` sites, all under `dependenttags.rules[]` -- zero collateral. The forbid row names the marker target; the three expect rows are the BOUNDARY: a template value at the same key still emits (a `${{ ... }}` edge is a RULED external claim, kept by the guard's `{{` exclusion), and the two real dependency shapes (compose sibling service, workflow job) still emit and resolve. authoredBeforeAnalyzerRun is FALSE and the reason is recorded the way this lane records it elsewhere: the fixture was authored AFTER the guard and its population price, from the measured class, which is a weaker form of independence than a pre-registered prediction and is not claimed as more.

expectRelationships.note: BOUNDARY 1: a template value at the same `dependsOn` key still emits -- the guard's `{{` exclusion is what keeps a ruled external claim out of the refusal.
BOUNDARY 2: a compose sibling service still emits and resolves -- no-colon values are untouched.
BOUNDARY 2: a workflow `needs:` still emits and resolves through the document-scoped identity.

forbidRelationships.note: THE GUARD: a dependency value naming a kubebuilder marker is not a reference into the document key space -- no analyzer publishes a symbol by that name, so the claim could never be confirmed.
